qs.s: Notre équipe a clairement défini sa ___ pour cette année : doubler les ventes.
qs.en: Our team clearly defined its target for this year: to double sales.

qs.s: Les jeunes adultes sont la ___ principale de cette campagne publicitaire.
qs.en: Young adults are the main target of this advertising campaign.

qs.en: The shooter hit the bullseye of the target with remarkable precision.

qs.en: During training, the soldiers practice aiming at the target from afar.

qs.en: He placed a target at the end of the hallway to practice.

qs.en: The archer missed the target and his arrow fell into the grass.

qs.en: The suspect was detained for forty-eight hours before being released.

qs.en: The activist was detained by the authorities for several days without explanation.

qs.en: The prisoner asked to meet his lawyer as soon as he arrived at the prison.

qs.en: Every prisoner has the right to receive family visits once a week.

qs.en: The men detained in this prison have access to sports activities.

qs.en: The woman detained for three days was finally released this morning.

qs.en: The journalist, detained by the local authorities, was able to contact her embassy.

qs.en: — Would you like a little more wine? — Gladly, yes please!

qs.s: Il ___ répond aux questions des étudiants après le cours.
qs.en: He willingly answers students' questions after class.

qs.s: Elle a ___ renoncé à ses vacances pour s'occuper de sa mère malade.
qs.en: She willingly gave up her vacation to look after her sick mother.

qs.en: The volunteers work wholeheartedly without expecting any reward.
